Greenville Police Conclude Investigation Into Death of Actress Hayden Panettiere

01 Nov 2026, 10:53 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily World Desk · Source: www.bbc.co.uk

Image: https://www.facebook.com/bbcnews · Source image rights not independently verified · Photo source · Cropped to 16:9; original source image

Key takeaways Official Ruling Law enforcement authorities in South Carolina have formally closed their local investigation into the death of actress Hayden Panettiere. The Greenville Police Department stated that, based on the medical examiner's findings, the death has been officia

Official Ruling

Law enforcement authorities in South Carolina have formally closed their local investigation into the death of actress Hayden Panettiere. The Greenville Police Department stated that, based on the medical examiner's findings, the death has been officially ruled as accidental.

Medical Findings

The Greenville County Coroner’s Office previously confirmed that Panettiere, 36, died due to the toxic effects of a combination of substances. According to the autopsy report, the presence of the following was identified in her system:

  • Fentanyl: A potent synthetic opioid.
  • Xanax: A prescription medication commonly used for anxiety.
  • Methocarbamol: A muscle relaxant.
  • Quetiapine: An anti-psychotic medication.

Emergency crews responded to a call regarding a woman in cardiac arrest at a residence on August 16. The coroner noted that the autopsy revealed no signs of trauma that contributed to her death. At the time of the incident, reports indicated that Brian Hickerson and Zack Hickerson were present at the scene.

Status of Federal Involvement

While the local police probe has concluded, the status of a reported investigation involving the US Drug Enforcement Agency (DEA) remains unclear. News outlets including CBS News previously reported that the DEA was investigating the circumstances surrounding the death; however, a spokesperson for the Greenville Police Department did not comment on the nature or current status of federal involvement when reached by media outlets.

Background

Panettiere was widely known for her roles in television series such as *Heroes* and *Nashville*. Throughout her career, she had been public about her experiences with substance abuse and the pressures associated with being a child performer in the entertainment industry.

Verifying Information

To confirm the details of this announcement, interested parties can refer to the official public statements issued by the Greenville Police Department and the Greenville County Coroner’s Office. Further updates regarding any ongoing federal probes would typically be released through official DEA press channels.
